import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

def task_func(df: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple:
    preferred_names = [
        "Close", "close", "CLOSE",
        "Closing Price", "closing price", "closing_price",
        "Adj Close", "adj close", "adj_close",
    ]

    close_col = next((col for col in preferred_names if col in df.columns), None)
    if close_col is None:
        close_col = next((col for col in df.columns if "close" in str(col).lower()), None)

    if close_col is not None:
        closing_prices = pd.to_numeric(df[close_col], errors="coerce")
        closing_prices = closing_prices[
            closing_prices.notna()
            & closing_prices.ne(float("inf"))
            & closing_prices.ne(float("-inf"))
        ]
    else:
        closing_prices = pd.Series(dtype="float64")

    fig, (ax_box, ax_hist) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))

    if not closing_prices.empty:
        sns.boxplot(y=closing_prices, ax=ax_box)
        sns.histplot(closing_prices, ax=ax_hist, kde=False)
    else:
        ax_box.set_xlim(0, 1)
        ax_box.set_ylim(0, 1)
        ax_hist.set_xlim(0, 1)
        ax_hist.set_ylim(0, 1)

    ax_box.set_title("Box Plot of Closing Prices")
    ax_box.set_ylabel("Closing Price")
    ax_box.set_xlabel("")

    ax_hist.set_title("Histogram of Closing Prices")
    ax_hist.set_xlabel("Closing Price")
    ax_hist.set_ylabel("Frequency")

    fig.tight_layout()
    return (ax_box, ax_hist)
